_source:
A real 'Geography Form 2 Scheme of Work' (a real Zambian secondary school's Social Science Department; the source's own teacher name and school name are not reproduced here per this app's standing sourcing policy) was shared with this project via Drive, as a single document titled 'Term 2-3'. This is a genuine gap fill — this app previously had no CBC Geography Form 2 content at all (only Form 1; this file is distinct from the separate OBC 'GEOG' Grade 10-12 Geography subject already bundled). Cites the real official '2024 Geography Syllabus Ordinary Secondary Education Form 1-4' with real page citations (pg. 20-24).

Only the Term 2 portion of this document has real, filled-in week-by-week content. Its Term 3 portion is a real page of its own (same header, 'TERM: 3') but contains no scheme table at all — every cell is blank, and the page's own body text reads only 'REVISIONS'. This is a genuine, honestly-disclosed gap, not a fabrication: Term 3 is not represented in this file's 'terms' array because the source document itself carries no actual Term 3 content to extract.

A real irregularity in the Term 2 content, preserved rather than 'corrected': Topic 2.2 'Basic Research Skills' begins mid-sequence at sub-topic 2.2.3 — sub-topics 2.2.1 and 2.2.2 are not present in this document (they most likely belong to Term 1, for which no source document was available). This file starts at 2.2.3 exactly as the source does, rather than inventing the missing earlier sub-topics.

The term document's own 'MID-TERM TESTS' week and its closing 'REVISION AND END OF YEAR EXAMINATIONS' block are excluded, since they name no new specific competences.

Content/Concept column text is summarised into each sub-topic's own description; the scheme's own Strategies/Methods and Materials/Resources columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled subject in this app.

grade.name: Form 2
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 2" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: 2.2 Basic Research Skills
topics.description: This document begins mid-sequence at sub-topic 2.2.3 — sub-topics 2.2.1 and 2.2.2 are not present in the available source (likely Term 1 content).

sub_topics.name: 2.2.3 Data Collection/Fieldwork
sub_topics.description: Sampling methods; types of data (primary and secondary); data collection tools; accurate recording of features.

sub_topics.name: 2.2.4 Data Processing
sub_topics.description: Organising, analysing, interpreting and discussing collected data.

sub_topics.name: 2.2.5 Presenting Findings
sub_topics.description: Writing a geography fieldwork report; creating visual presentations (maps, infographics); communicating results.

competencies.description: Use findings to address local challenges

sub_topics.name: 2.3.1 Environment Degradation
sub_topics.description: Meaning of environmental degradation; its causes and impacts.

sub_topics.name: 2.3.2 Environmental Protection
sub_topics.description: Sustainable management practices for waste, soil, water and biodiversity.

sub_topics.name: 2.3.3 Environmental Hazards and Disasters
sub_topics.description: Types of hazards and disasters (floods, drought, etc.); their impacts; response and mitigation.

competencies.description: Respond to natural hazards and disasters

sub_topics.name: 2.4.1 Zambia's Agro-Ecological Regions
sub_topics.description: Zambia's soil types and their coverage; Zambia's Agro-Ecological Regions (AER).

sub_topics.name: 2.4.2 Climate and Agro-Ecological Regions
sub_topics.description: Relationship between rainfall and AER (rainfall ranges for AER I, II, III); practical applications in farming.

competencies.description: Establish relationship between climate and Agro-Ecological Regions

sub_topics.name: 2.4.3 Agriculture and Agro-Ecological Regions
sub_topics.description: Dominant agricultural activities in each AER; applying knowledge to local conditions.

competencies.description: Show a relationship between Agriculture and Agro-Ecological Regions
